tier1Sources.author: Katie Barton + Debbie Wolfe + Tiffany Lewis + Paul Rankin
tier1Sources.methodology: 5 weeks of testing 7 top-rated steam mops; dried-on-food challenge; everyday mess cleanup
tier1Sources.editorialClaim: Most steam mops are safe for use on ceramic tile, grout, sealed wood floors, linoleum, or laminate floors. However, shoppers will want to check the flooring manufacturer's care instructions. If the flooring is fragile, heavy-duty cleaning from steam mops may do more harm than good. The extreme temperature and moisture from steam cleaners could warp the wood, including hardwood floors and engineered wood flooring.

picks.name: Bissell PowerFresh Scrubbing & Sanitizing Steam Mop (Model 1940)
picks.claim: Kills 99% germs and bacteria. Three steam settings. 23-foot power cord. Swivel steering. Low-profile mophead maneuvers under cabinets. Flip-down scrubber for grout.

picks.name: PurSteam 10-in-1 Steam Mop Cleaner
picks.claim: 30-second preheat. 11.5-ounce reservoir. 20-25 minutes cleaning on lowest setting. Powered through stuck-on messes better than any other model tested. Cord is 15.9 feet (short).

picks.name: Bissell PowerFresh Vac & Steam
picks.claim: 2-in-1 model. Cyclonic vacuum picked up dog hair and grit while steam sanitized. Dry tank keeps debris separate from moisture.

picks.name: Shark Genius Steam Pocket Mop System
